techniques.description:
The sample has code paths that fetch a body over WinINet and either write it to disk and run it, or run it from memory. Execution is not shown.

techniques.name: System Checks
techniques.description: [Environment check on system-property thresholds] Routine 0x8560 maps the OS version to a code from 0 to 7 (code 6 is Windows 10; code 7 is Windows 11, build 21999 or later). Routine 0x8820 counts running processes with a Toolhelp snapshot. Routine 0x3868 exits with failure (-1) when the process count is below 75 on code 6 or higher, or below 50 on lower codes. The failure stalls the export (claim 39). These are host-property thresholds compared before the beacon starts, followed by an exit after the check.
